Lina (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — we're running a driver bundle freeze preflight for the marketplace listing next Wed. Need partner validation + regression sign-off by EOD Tue. @Cheng can you confirm HW validation windows? :calendar:
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Yup. I'll kick off the smoke/regression matrix today against the candidate bundles. Will prioritize latency SLOs and KV cache behavior.
Cheng (HW Partner): We can run our validation farm Mon–Tue. Note: we observed a perf jitter on a small subset with CUDA12.2-rc3 on A100 Gen2. I'll upload logs to the shared folder. :eyes:
Sam (Product): Please include two config profiles: 1) low-latency (single-request) 2) throughput (batch 64). Enterprise customers flagged batch tail latency.
Lina (Partnerships): Attached the checklist and the proposed pinned set — plz review. Link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/driver-freeze-2812
```
PROPOSED BUNDLE v2028-12-01
- CUDA: 12.1.0
- cuDNN: 8.9.2
- ROCm: 5.4.1
- NVIDIA driver: 535.86
- Linux kernel: 5.15.0-101
- libc: glibc 2.31
Smoke tests: tinybert/bert-large/gpt2-small end-to-end latency + perf counters
```
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Suggest adding a fallback lane: if driver 535.86 fails perf threshold, route to 535.54 variant (lower perf but stable). We can express that in routing policy as `driver_fallback: true`.
Cheng (HW Partner): We'll run both 535.86 and 535.54 across our SKUs. Expect results by Tue noon PT.
Harper (Legal): Reminder: if we change pinned drivers close to a joint announcement, we need 48h signoff on partner marketing and compliance wording. Flagging now.
Sam (Product): Good call @Harper. Lina — let's aim to finalize bundle Thu so materials can be queued.
Lina (Partnerships): Timeline sounds good. Two outstanding asks: (1) Mike — add stress test for streaming long-sequence KV cache pressure, (2) Cheng — vendor-signed binary checksums for the pinned drivers.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): On it. I'll add a `kv-cache-stress` job in CI and attach logs. Quick command I ran locally: 
```
./run_stress.sh --model gpt2-small --seq 4096 --concurrency 8 --duration 1800
```
Cheng (HW Partner): We'll provide signed checksums + a short note about validated SKUs. Expect artifacts in the shared folder.
ops-bot: Deployment window registered: 2028-12-01 02:00 UTC — preflight gating enabled.
Lina (Partnerships): Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. I'll consolidate results and send the partner-facing summary Wed evening. :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Quick status update: started matrix run 90% queued, small failures around tensorcore kernels — investigating. Will DM logs.
Cheng (HW Partner): Received. We're rerunning with kernel 5.10 on a few legacy nodes (per Sam request) and will include those numbers.
Sam (Product): Thanks — that legacy kernel data is important for a subset of cloud marketplace SKUs.
Harper (Legal): FYI — added a short checklist item: confirm export control classification before publishing any driver binaries in the marketplace listing.
Lina (Partnerships): Noted. Final reminder: deliverables by Tue EOD: partner logs, signed checksums, regression matrix CSV, and a short compatibility statement (1–2 paragraphs).
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Will deliver the CSV + logs by Tue 18:00 PT.
Cheng (HW Partner): Same from our side.
Lina (Partnerships): Great — closing thread for now, will reopen if any regressions show up. :wave:
